stemMd: Which transformation turns the graph of y = f(x) into y = f(x − 3) + 2?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A shift 3 units right and 2 units up

options.label: B
options.textMd: A vertical stretch by 3 and shift up by 2

options.label: C
options.textMd: A shift 3 units left and 2 units up

options.label: D
options.textMd: A shift 3 units right and 2 units down

explanationMd: A point with old input a appears at x = a + 3 because x − 3 = a. Thus the graph shifts right three units. Adding two to the output then shifts every point upward two units.

distractorRationale.c: The horizontal input shift has the opposite direction to the sign inside.
distractorRationale.b: The three is subtracted inside the input, not multiplied outside.
distractorRationale.e: No negation of input or output is present.
